Package com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller

Class AdminController

java.lang.Object
com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller.AdminController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/admin") @PreAuthorize("hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") @CrossOrigin(origins="*") public class AdminController extends Object
Controller for admin-specific operations. Provides endpoints for dashboard statistics, pending bookings and offers, reports, subject management, and global settings.
Version:
1.2
Author:
EduLink Team

      list of OfferDto objects with status PENDING
